summary: Comprehensive regression on Punch Desk premium refactor. Backend pytest suite grew to 20 tests covering health, config, OTP demo auth, profile enums+photo+location, discovery (with coordinate hiding), reciprocal like -> match with explanation.sharedInterests, matches list, chat REST + WebSocket message/typing delivery + bad-token rejection, photo requests, blocks (bidirectional discovery hide), reports (unsupported category + self-report), support tickets, admin key protection, and subscription plans/mine. All 20 backend tests passed on the public preview URL. Frontend flow verified on 390x844 viewport: welcome -> phone -> demo OTP 123456 (auto-fill hint visible) -> permissions -> setup -> Discover with tabs Discover/Messages/Profile, more sheet with Request photos/Report/Block actions, Profile shows Support entry and help icon in header. Deprecated packages check: none of expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch are used.

integration_issues.issue: Header briefly displays 'Reconnecting…' after login even though backend accepts the ws (verified in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log). Not a functional bug, but consider hiding the label until first onclose or after a small delay for polish.

action_items: Optional: delay the 'Reconnecting…' pill by ~1.5s so the initial connection race does not flash to users on cold-start.
Optional: set a >=32 byte JWT_SECRET in production to remove PyJWT InsecureKeyLengthWarning already noted in iteration_2.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py delegates cleanly to app.main.create_app(); router modularisation looks solid.
Discovery correctly strips 'location' before returning public profiles (see core.public_profile).
WebSocket route uses jwt.decode with HS256 – token expiry handled implicitly by PyJWT; consider explicit 4402 vs 4401 codes for token expired vs invalid to help client-side logout logic.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed users (TEST_UserA, TEST_UserB, TEST_UI, TEST_UI2) and TEST_-prefixed support ticket via the regression suite; no manual DB seeds added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_punchdesk_regression.py and depends on the `websockets` python package plus EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exported from /app/frontend/.env. It creates TEST_ prefixed users; adjust phone prefix generation if collisions occur. WebSocket parity test cross-connects two users to conversation created via reciprocal like, so run the whole file together. Admin endpoints return 503 with no ADMIN_API_KEY configured; subscription plans list is fine to hit but /api/subscriptions/checkout should NOT be triggered (live Razorpay keys).
